name: cache
description: Installs Memcached and configures a Redis server with authentication, logging storage, service enablement, and replication-related configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, including its Python virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user, environment settings, and a systemd Uvicorn service.

description: Builds a hardened Nginx static multi-site host with three TLS virtual hosts. It configures site content, self-signed certificates, Fail2ban, UFW, kernel hardening, and SSH restrictions.
